success_criteria_results.criterion: Subagent sidebar shows text messages and TodoWrite calls
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code review of reducerTracer.ts fix -- removed isUuidLike check, all parent references now buffered as orphans. No sessions with Agent tool calls available in dev environment for browser testing.
success_criteria_results.details: reducerTracer.ts:277-286 -- The else branch (parent not yet processed) now unconditionally buffers messages as orphans regardless of parent ID format. Previously, isUuidLike() rejected CUID2 parent references (e.g., 'cm...') causing subagent messages to be inserted as standalone instead of being buffered for their parent. The comment at line 279-282 explicitly documents this fix. processOrphans() at lines 131-169 correctly flushes buffered messages when parent arrives. toolCallToMessageId map (line 74) also supports session protocol subagent IDs via getToolCallParentIds (line 117-124) which includes sessionSubagent.
evidence: reducerTracer.ts:277-286 -- unconditional orphan buffering for all unresolved parent references
reducerTracer.ts:279-282 -- comment: 'This covers both UUID-like parent references and non-UUID ones (e.g. CUID2 subagent ids)'
reducerTracer.ts:117-124 -- getToolCallParentIds includes sessionSubagent for CUID2 support
reducerTracer.ts:189-193 -- processOrphans flushed when parent tool call registered

root_cause_verification.rationale: Issue 1: CLI now reads file content and injects into tool-call-end output via enrichToolResultOutput() -- addresses the gap where tool.result had no file content. Issue 2: permissionAnswersStore persists answers independently of agentState -- addresses the loss of answers on component remount. Issue 3: Removed isUuidLike() check in reducerTracer -- addresses CUID2 parent references being rejected instead of buffered as orphans.
